description.value: Pearkes Recreation Centre is a municipally operated multi-sport facility run by Saanich Parks & Recreation in the Tillicum neighbourhood of Victoria. As a full-service community recreation centre, it serves as a practical stop for touring cyclists passing through the western side of the city. The centre is publicly accessible and part of the broader Saanich Parks & Recreation network.
